description: One Instagram post a day, finished: the skill that writes it in the brand's voice and looks at the image it made, the `save_post` tool that owns the format, and the Posts tab where the client reads it and downloads the pieces
client_copy: Posteos para Instagram con tu voz y tu identidad: cada día te deja uno listo para revisar y bajar.
_comment: IT REPLACES social-content, post-image AND brand-kit, and it is not a port
of them (docs/own-agent-plan.md, wave 3). Those three were Hermes-era: a
skeleton script, a brief builder and a site scraper, all of them prose and
scaffolding around an `image_generate` tool that no longer exists. What
survived is what they LEARNED -- the caption formula, the five-hashtag cap,
the checklist that looks at the piece before it goes out, «entregá lo que
está bien aunque falte una pieza» -- and it is in skills/post/SKILL.md, in
eighty lines instead of four files.
THE BRAND IS A FILE THE WORKSPACE CARRIES, which is why brand-kit is not
rebuilt. `marca/brand.md` is written at onboarding, the skill reads it and
the code never parses it: the colours, the voice and the claims a company
can make are the client's, not a schema of ours.
IT REQUIRES `image` AND NOTHING ELSE. A post without a piece is still a
post -- that is the fallback when the checklist fails twice -- but a
capability that sells «tus redes con tu identidad» and cannot make the
picture is selling half of it, so the dependency is declared and the
capability row installs both.
THE core SURFACE IS THIS ENGINE'S AND A HERMES AGENT NEVER OPENS IT, the
same shape as `image` and `memory`. What is new here is that it carries a
SKILL and a TAB on top of `core/`: the tool and the routes are the format,
the skill is the craft, and `tab.builtin` names the page app/app/posts/
draws from `GET /portal/posts`.
ON `core` THE SKILL AND THE TOOL ARE A SUB-AGENT'S, not the face's
(docs/subagents-plan.md). `core/creator.py` builds the agent that makes
the post -- the only one with `save_post` and with the image capability --
and the face delegates to it and reads its report out to the client. That
is why the module declares `SKILLS = []`: the skill file is still this
plugin's and still travels, it is this engine's INDEX it stays out of,
because the face no longer has the tools the procedure names.
